record.rationale: React browser file presentation and platform orchestration consume actual suite model/filter/medium owners and source command identities;no native VCL implementation file is falsely assigned as the browser implementation owner.
responsibilities: Task2BTWEE extracts the actual Writer file-dialog presentation,dialog header,primary-name collision choices and observable file-dialog request owner into framework/browser. Suite adapters supply supported formats,canonical IO callbacks and primary stores;shared presentation owns only tab,busy,error,drop and collision drafts. Writer preserves ODT/TXT behavior,its modal marker and existing primary-save policy. Shared office-dialog CSS aliases retain original Writer styling and responsive layout. Calc uses this same presentation for ODS files;no duplicate suite-specific file UI implementation or recovery UI is introduced.

stackDivergence.rationale: React DOM and browser primary file choices share the existing Writer visual style and deliberate save/open policy.
